morphology.pattern_note: 英语姓氏整词记忆，无马来语词缀；正常书写为 Shakespeare。不能把现代拼写中的片段当作马来语词根或词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 莎士比亚；英语姓氏，在文学语境中通常指英国剧作家、诗人威廉·莎士比亚（1564—1616）。
senses.en_definition: An English surname, usually referring in literary contexts to William Shakespeare (1564–1616), the English playwright and poet.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Inggeris yang dalam konteks kesusasteraan lazimnya merujuk kepada William Shakespeare, penulis drama dan penyair Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，应大写为 Shakespeare。文学讨论中也可借指其作品；例如 membaca Shakespeare 通常是“读莎士比亚的作品”。人物资料见 [Shakespeare Birthplace Trust](https://www.shakespeare.org.uk/explore-shakespeare/shakespedia/william-shakespeare/william-shakespeare-biography/)。音标采用英式英语读音，见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/shakespeare)。status 按指定结构保留，不表示已核实为 DBP 普通词词条。

etymology.historical_story: Shakespeare is an English family name whose literary prominence comes from William Shakespeare. His career joined acting, playwriting and partnership in a London theatre company. Today, his surname can identify either the historical writer or, by association, the works readers study and actors perform. In Malay, it remains a proper name rather than a native derivative. Source: [Folger Shakespeare Library](https://www.folger.edu/explore/shakespeares-life/).

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 学术文章首次提及时可写全名 William Shakespeare，后文使用 Shakespeare；通常不需添加现代社交称谓 Encik。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论人物、作品与演出时均可使用。引用名句须核实原文及出处；说 membaca Shakespeare 时，应让上下文明确所指是他的作品。
